name: documentary_validation
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
r=json.loads((p/'review.json').read_text())['323694'];f=json.loads((p/'family-comparison96.json').read_text())
assert len(f['comparisons'])==96
assert all(x['actual_scope_fields'] and x['comparison'] for x in f['comparisons'])
assert r['gates']['acceptance']['credit']==0
assert all((p/x).is_file() for x in ['REVIEW.md','PROOF.md','source-map.json','read-access-inventory.json'])
receipts=[]
for x in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 v=json.loads(x.read_text());receipts.append({'file':x.name,'exit':v['exit'],'killed':v['killed'],'wall_s':v['wall_s'],'sampled_peak':v['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes']})
print('DOCUMENTARY_CHECK_OK',len(f['comparisons']), 'scope rows; prior completed receipts',len(receipts));print(json.dumps(receipts))
policy={'manifest':'SHA256-MANIFEST.json','scope':'Every own regular file recursively at terminal seal, with these exact exclusions only. No external or symlink traversal.','excluded':['SHA256-MANIFEST.json','terminal_seal.receipt.json','terminal_seal.output.txt'],'reasons':{'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'Cannot include its own bytes/hash noncircularly.','terminal_seal.receipt.json':'Immutable runner creates this only after manifest child has completed.','terminal_seal.output.txt':'Immutable runner creates this only after manifest child has completed.'},'included':'TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json, receipt-inventory.json, frozen-after.json, all earlier completed receipts/output logs, helpers, inputs, cached responses, counters, products, renders; no fresh plans/payloads/charges exist.','after_seal':'No further file mutation or verification request; hand back.'}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json'],input=json.dumps(policy,indent=2)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert z.returncode==0
